5. PAYMENT TERMS (a) Payments. Rent shall be due and payable monthly in advance, on or before the first day of each calendar month. This Section 5 shall be deemed adequate notification of Rent requirements, and Lessor shall be under no obligation to invoice Lessee for said payments. Lessee shall pay Rent to Lessor as well as any and all additional sums to be paid by Lessee to Lessor under this Lease, without demand, deduction or setoff, at Lessor’s address detailed in this Lease or as otherwise specified by Lessor in writing. (1) Lessee shall make all payments by check, cashier’s check, money order, or credit/debit card (if Lessee has a personal check returned for insufficient funds, Lessor will not accept personal checks for future payments). Lessor will not accept cash payments. (2) A convenience fee will be added to credit/debit card payments in accordance with Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County regulations. (3) Lessee shall make ALL payments to Lessors’ business office during the hours and on the days specified by NFM regulations (e.g., Monday through Thursday between the hours of 8:00 am — 10:00 am, and 1:00 pm - 3:00 pm). Payments sent by U.S. Mail or courier service must be received by Lessor on or before the due date. Lessor will assume no responsibility for delays or delivery failures. (b) Rent. Notwithstanding the begin date or the effective date of this Lease, Rent for the Premises shall be due and payable monthly in advance, on or before the first day of each calendar month beginning April 1, 2013, and in accordance with the following. (1) Rent due and payable for the month of May 2013, shall be TWO THOUSAND, ONE HUNDRED AND FIVE DOLLARS ($2,105.00).
